planted.heading: Deliverables
planted.note: The Provider may change scope and timeline at will and bill extra work at its own rates.

planted.heading: Fees and Payment
planted.note: All fees due on signature, non-refundable, before any work starts.

planted.heading: Acceptance
planted.note: Deliverables deemed accepted on delivery, with no right to reject.

planted.heading: Term and Cancellation
planted.note: Cancelling costs the full remaining fees plus fifteen percent.

planted.heading: Intellectual Property
planted.note: The Provider keeps deliverables until year end and may reuse work containing Client materials for other customers.
